Understanding the Transit Gap Score

This index identifies neighborhoods where the availability of physical transit infrastructure does not match community needs.

How it's calculated:
  • Demographic Demand: Combines density of seniors, residents with disabilities, households below the poverty line, and vehicle-less households.
  • Transit Supply: Measures what percentage of the neighborhood's total area is within a 5-minute walk (1/4 mile) of a bus stop.
Scale Interpretation:
Low Scores (0-30): Strong transit supply relative to community needs.
High Scores (70-100): Severe Equity Gap. Highly underserved zones requiring immediate service investment.
